name: Cairenn

attributes.attribute: mother of Niall of the Nine Hostages
high king and first lord of Tara
first wife of Eochaid and rival of Cairenn

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text:
Cairenn is an Irish heroine. She was the wife of King Eochaid Mugmedon. Legend calls her a British princess. Captors took her from Britain into slavery in Ireland. She gave birth to Niall of the Nine Hostages. Her son Niall became a high king of Tara. The O'Neill line claims descent from him.

Eochaid had a first wife named Mongfhinn. She was jealous of Cairenn. Cairenn left the court at Tara. She gave birth beside a hallowed well. The old tales of Niall mix history with myth. They tell the story of other early Irish kings in the same way.

okr.objective: An Irish heroine whose son carried the royal line of Tara.
key_results: Cairenn gave birth to Niall of the Nine Hostages.
